summary: AerCap Holdings N.V. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report of financial results, not a special-situation event. It includes balance sheets, income statements, segment information, and notes on leasing activities, debt, and equity. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is announced. The filing is a standard earnings update for a foreign private issuer.
